# Golden fixtures

Generated by `cargo test -p tmgr-chat-relay --test fixtures -- --ignored write_fixtures` from fixed keys
(secret bytes are repeated single bytes) and fixed entropy. `fixtures_are_current` fails if a file differs
by one byte. Spec: `docs/plans/2026-11-21-tm-1017-e2e-relay.md` v1.3 sections 2-3.

Every file except `trust.json` is `{description, inputs, outputs}`. A TS port feeds `inputs` to its own
implementation and must reproduce `outputs` byte for byte. Hex fields end in `_hex`, public keys are base64
STANDARD padded, secrets are test keys only.

- `chat.json`, `blob.json`: inputs are `user_id`, `now_ms`, `sender`/`recipient` (`device_id`, `keys`),
  `kind`, `msg_id`, `sent_at_ms`, `seq`, `payload`, `entropy` (`eph_secret_hex`, `nonce_hex`).
  Outputs: `ctx`, `inner` (exact string that is hashed and signed), `inner_sha256_hex`, `signed_string`, `sig`
  (ECDSA is deterministic, DER low-S), `plaintext` (padded to 1024 bytes, `plaintext_len`), `body` (padded),
  `plaintext_unpadded`, `body_unpadded`, and `open` (the expected result of opening `body` at `now_ms`; also
  valid for `body_unpadded`). `keys` holds `sign_secret_hex`, `kex_secret_hex`, `sign_pub`, `kex_pub`, `fp`.
- `intro.json`: inputs `user_id`, `introducer`, `target` (with `kind`), `issued_at_ms`; outputs `statement`,
  `sig`, `intro_json`.
- `revoke.json`: inputs `user_id`, `revoker`, `target`, `issued_at_ms`; outputs `statement`, `sig`,
  `revoke_json` (the string for `POST /revocations`).
- `join.json`: inputs `code` (`secret_hex` is the MAC key, `secret_b64` is what the code carries) and `joiner`;
  outputs `code_string`, `code_base64url`, `mac_transcript`, `mac_hex`.
- `spawnkey.json`: inputs `user_id`, `device`, `spawn_secret_hex`, `spawn_pub`, `issued_at_ms`; outputs
  `statement`, `sig`, `spawn_sig`, `payload`.
- `trust.json`: `cases[]`, each `{name, note, inputs: {pins [[id, fp]], revoked [fp], intros [intro_json],
  directory [{device_id, sign_pub, kex_pub}]}, outputs: {trusted [[id, fp]]}}`. `trusted` is sorted by
  (id, fp). `intros` is the union of directory and locally cached intros.
